quadrature_separation: every cell is re-measured on a second quadrature order and the relative drift is reported; a large drift means the optimizer found a strain field the certified grid does not resolve, so that cell's Lam is a quadrature artifact rather than a Rayleigh quotient
scoring: unchanged from P1-P4: MAC >= 0.9, e_lam <= 0.05, four outcomes, 95 % Wilson; the seed count is 20 rather than 50, so the intervals are wider and the captions say so
